theorems.name: Submission.lpf_tde_mcd_countable_glue
theorems.statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] [Zero Y] (S : ℕ → Set X) (G : ℕ → X → Y), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (S j)) → (∀ j, Measurable (G j)) → ∃ L : X → Y, Measurable L ∧ (∀ x, x ∉ (⋃ j, S j) → L x = 0) ∧ ∀ x ∈ (⋃ j, S j), ∃ j, x ∈ S j ∧ L x = G j x
